gordian_traps.name: Isolated Agents Trap
gordian_traps.what_happened: Built N vehicles with separate Historization on same topology. Four commits fixing symptoms (epistemic trust, surprise dampening, adaptive observation) instead of cause.
gordian_traps.root_cause: Competition test instead of cooperation. Leitsystem concept introduced but not watched through implementation.
gordian_traps.lesson: When agents share a domain, check first: do they share knowledge? Multiverse infrastructure (C60-68) exists for exactly this.

gordian_traps.name: Blind Trust Trap
gordian_traps.what_happened: All adversarial defenses trusted the Outcome signal. Injection attacks succeeded 3/3.
gordian_traps.root_cause: Defense-in-depth only at edge level, not at outcome level.
gordian_traps.resolution: C173 structural skepticism (partial), C174 self-honesty (partial). Still open.
gordian_traps.lesson: Any signal E₀ relies on can be poisoned. Always ask: what if this signal lies?

gordian_traps.name: Greedy Matching Trap
gordian_traps.what_happened: Six commits improving features (4-dim→9-dim, edge→node, context scoring) gained only +9. Matching was the actual bottleneck.
gordian_traps.root_cause: Assumed feature quality drove accuracy. Mutual-best matching causes cascading errors — one wrong pair poisons neighbors.
gordian_traps.lesson: When incremental improvements stall, the bottleneck may not be where you think. Step back and question the pipeline.

gordian_traps.name: Distance Collapse Trap
gordian_traps.what_happened: Dictionary bootstrap saturates: distances converge to 1, discrimination lost, wrong pairs accumulate votes.
gordian_traps.root_cause: Adding entries changes the landscape, which changes all distances. Feedback loop collapses the signal.
gordian_traps.resolution: Level-3 neighborhood consistency (C128) gates promotion by structural context.
gordian_traps.lesson: Self-modifying systems can destroy their own discrimination signal. Monitor signal quality, not just accuracy.

breakthroughs.name: Hungarian Matching
breakthroughs.insight: Feature engineering is NOT the bottleneck — matching strategy is. Global optimal assignment avoids cascading errors from greedy matching.

breakthroughs.name: Shared Historization
breakthroughs.insight: Cooperation effect SCALES with congestion. Shared knowledge prevents problems before they happen. coop+adapt = plain coop (shared hist already prevents surprises).

breakthroughs.name: Epistemic Liveness
breakthroughs.insight: F=0 traps the system forever — greedy never escapes (proved with 10k steps). Zweifel zuzulassen (allowing doubt) is structurally necessary, not a flaw.

perspective_checks._comment: Our Amplitude Override. Questions that force perspective shifts before committing to an approach. Update 'triggered' when a check actually catches something.

checks.question: Are agents sharing knowledge or isolated? If isolated — is that intentional?
Am I testing what I think I'm testing? (Competition vs. Cooperation)
Which existing infrastructure (Multiverse, Dream, Curriculum, Sleep-Wake) applies here but isn't being used?
If incremental improvements stall after 3+ commits, is the bottleneck where I think it is?
If this test fails — what do I learn? If nothing — redesign the test.
Am I fixing the right problem, or building around a wrong assumption?
What if this signal lies? (Outcome, quality, distance — any input can be poisoned)

working_principles.principle: Historization is the dominant mechanism — other features add incremental value
Cooperation > Competition — always check for shared knowledge first
Quality over Quantity — few high-confidence interventions beat many low-confidence ones
When incremental gains stall, question the pipeline — the bottleneck is elsewhere
Self-modifying systems can destroy their own signal — monitor signal quality
Zweifel zuzulassen — doubt (F>0) is structurally necessary, not a flaw

8_observation.purpose: E₀ observes its own landscape as a navigable domain. O-Landscape (scoped projection with focus/move/defocus), ObservationController (session-aware navigation), RenderingAdapter (→ GraphView wire format). Wired to server (3 REST endpoints) and client (Observe toggle + node-click navigation).

9_dream_mode.purpose: Passive cross-domain pattern recognition. EdgeFingerprint f(e)=(q,m,I,cs), functional equivalence detection (quantile-based), DreamObserver (N domains, dream_cycle, feedback historization), bridge hypothesis generation (→ cross_propose_edges), make_dream_peer_fn (E0Controller integration). WL recursive fingerprints (9-dim→81-dim at depth-2), Hungarian optimal assignment (find_wl_node_equivalences_hungarian, scipy). **C139:** DreamObserver.dream_cycle() invokes node-level equivalences (hungarian/wl) alongside edge-EQ. _update_dream_landscape_nodes creates domain:node states. **C154:** node_equivalences_for query, propose_node_bridges (structural transfer from donor neighborhoods via node mapping), make_dream_peer_fn node-bridge fallback, confidence_floor (breaks cold-start chicken-and-egg), equivalences_for now filters out node states. **C168:** dream_compatibility() (mean WL distance as structural compatibility metric), is_dream_compatible() (threshold check), compatibility-gated dream_cycle() (skips incompatible domain pairs, reports compatibility_skipped/compatibility_scores). **C178:** 4D fingerprint adds context_sensitivity to EdgeFingerprint and fingerprint_distance, preventing false equivalences between causal and confounded edges. Empirical: EN↔DE=0.375 PASS, EN↔ONTO=0.870 SKIP, 59% edge noise filtered. C109-C112, C135-C139, C154, C168, C178.

10_structural_entropy.purpose: Forgetting as structural necessity. Type 1: inscription threshold (novelty > ε, controlled by T_s). Type 2: anchor analysis (anchor_score = |q̄|·m_max·log(1+deg)), decay candidates, apply_decay (3-phase: trace→remove→clean). Controller: inscription_threshold opt-in. Dream: decay_enabled opt-in. Only new parameter: θ_base (anchor threshold). C114-C120.

11_sleep_wake.purpose: Automatic sleep-wake rhythm. dream_pressure = T_s/(T_s+μ) triggers dreaming when T_s > μ. SleepWakeCycle orchestrates Controller + DreamObserver: wake builds experience, sleep consolidates + decays, cycle repeats. Parameter-free trigger (uses existing μ). **C154:** wire_peer_fns() auto-creates dream peer_fns for all registered controllers (edge + node bridge support). C121, C154.

12_curriculum.purpose: Hierarchical learning for canonical landscapes. CurriculumStrategy generates cumulative turns from derivation levels. EquilibriumDetector monitors T_s stability (replaces goal-reaching as stop). build_scoped_landscape creates sub-landscapes per turn. transfer_historization carries traces across turns. CurriculumRunner orchestrates end-to-end. C123.

13_human_communication.purpose: E0 learns to communicate with humans. Perception Ontology (Gestalt primitives as landscape domain), Communication Intent (state → what to say), UI-Schema Emitter (Intent × Perception → UISpec), Human Feedback Loop (closes learning cycle), UI Renderer (UISpec → HTML). Visual pretraining: LLM evaluates rendering options, memo persistence. C158-C164.

14_session_runner.purpose: Unified end-to-end pipeline: task → LLM-derived endpoints → Controller navigation → Perception → Intent → UISpec → HTML. CLI interface (--task/--start/--goal/--canon/--save). Mock mode without LLM. LLM derives start/goal states from task description when not provided. C165-C166b.

key_formulas.effective_resistance: R_eff(e) = R₀(e) + δ_H(U,F) [or δ_H·trust(e) when epistemic_trust=True]
key_formulas.navigation: argmin S_eff/(M_H·I) (greedy with overlap+inertia), with amplitude override when Δ·conf > threshold
key_formulas.graduated_overlap: M_H(x→y) = max(0.2, Σ_z √(v(x,z)·v(z,y))), greedy divides S_eff by M_H
key_formulas.inertia_factor: I(e) = 1 − α·(m/(m+μ))·(1−|q|), greedy divides S_eff by I
